excerpt.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
excerpt.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

texts.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
texts.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

sections.zh:
在遥远的启始之时，先祖已有之。

在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的生活困苦且充满竞争，而强大的先祖还是能够开疆拓土。统治如此巨大的疆域很快难以为继，因此先祖创造了第一个子嗣。很快发现，子嗣显然无法自行管理一切，反之他们产出低级工蜂来帮助管理我们的家园。

让我们第一次试探性地跨出[capital_scope.System.GetName]的一步，我们的先祖便将自己隔绝于一个特化的巢穴中。受益于这些更好更流畅的控制体系，我们已经时刻准备着将先祖的影响力投射于整个星系了，正如他过去和现在所做一般，直至未来。而[Root.GetName]将见证一切。
sections.en:
In the beginning, the Progenitor was.

Life on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] was harsh and competitive, yet still the mighty Progenitor expanded its territory. Running such a vast dominion soon grew untenable, so the Progenitor created the first Offspring. In time, it became apparent that the Offspring could not manage alone. In turn, they produced menial drones to assist in taming our home.

As we took our first tentative steps across the [capital_scope.System.GetName] system, our Progenitor sequestered itself into a specialized nest. Endowed with greater, streamlined control, we are now ready to spread our Progenitor's influence to all the stars of the galaxy - for the Progenitor was, is, and will be. The [Root.GetName] will see it so.

sections.zh:
在遥远的启始之时，先祖已有之。

虚空之中的生活困苦且充满竞争，然而强大的先祖仍能不断成长，虫群不断增殖，填满了这艘巨大飞船的每一层甲板、每一间舱室。随着要统御的意识越来越多，局势很快难以为继，于是先祖创造了第一个子嗣。随着时间推移，子嗣们也逐渐难以独自承担管理之责。于是，它们又创造出了低级工蜂来引导这场伟大的迁徙。

随着我们的舰队不断壮大，先祖将自己闭关在一艘专门的指挥舰中。在获得了更强大、更高效的统御能力之后，我们已经时刻准备着将先祖的影响力投射于整个星系了，正如他过去和现在所做一般，直至未来。而[Root.GetName]将见证一切。
sections.en:
In the beginning, the Progenitor was.

Life in the void is harsh and competitive, yet still the mighty Progenitor grew, its swarm multiplying, filling every deck and chamber of the great vessel. Directing so many minds soon grew untenable, so the Progenitor created the first Offspring. In time, it became apparent that the Offspring could not manage alone. In turn, they produced menial drones to assist in guiding the great migration.

As our fleet grew, our Progenitor sequestered itself into a specialized command vessel. Endowed with greater, streamlined control, we are now ready to spread our Progenitor's influence to all the stars of the galaxy, for the Progenitor was, is, and will be. The [Root.GetName] will see it so.

texts.zh:
难以置信的事情发生了。我们的首都已落入卑鄙的[From.GetName]的[From.species.GetHandNamePlural]手中。在最近[Root.GetName]的绝望的防御战中，我们的先祖落入了令人憎恶的入侵者的受众，并带走了许多[From.GetSpeciesAdj]。

为了以防万一，我们深思熟虑的先祖已经在诸多子嗣中安排好了继位者。这位备选继位者能够稳定我们蜂巢意识的一部分，但重新管控整个意识的复杂性和压力超出其能力范畴。在敌人趁我们陷入短暂的混乱而获取更大优势之前，我们必须尽快催熟这位子嗣，使其成为新的一位先祖。
texts.en:
The unimaginable has happened. Our capital has fallen into the [From.species.GetHandNamePlural] of the despicable [From.GetName]. During the last desperate defense of [Root.GetName], our Progenitor fell to the horrid invaders, taking many of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] with them.

In case of the unthinkable, our ever-calculating Progenitor had designated a successor among the Offspring. The Progenitor-in-waiting has managed to stabilize parts of our consciousness, but the complexity and pressure are too great for it to fully take up the mantle. We will have to incubate this Offspring and have it take over as a new Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of our momentary disunity.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]遭到了可怖的[From.GetAdj]巨像武器的打击。我们失去的不仅仅是这个星球，还有我们的始祖以及所有居住在这个[Root.GetPlanetHabitat]上的子嗣。[Root.GetName]上的每一个子嗣和子个体都集结在一起，尽全力保护我们的始祖不受这个可怕武器的攻击。最终，它们的所有努力都只不过是延缓了无可避免的厄运，始祖很快陨落了。

现在我们的主体意识里满是矛盾碰撞的思想和冲动。如果我们不马上指派一名新的始祖，[Owner.GetName]很快就会停止生命。
texts.en:
[Root.GetName] has been struck with a Colossus weapon from the dreaded [From.GetAdj]. We lost not only the world but also our Progenitor, and all Offspring residing on the [Root.GetPlanetHabitat]. Every drone and Offspring on [Root.GetName] had gathered in an effort to protect our Progenitor from the dreaded machine. In the end, their efforts did naught but prolong the inevitable, and the Progenitor fell soon after.

Now our consciousness is full of clashing thoughts and impulses. If we do not appoint a new Progenitor soon, then the [Owner.GetName] will cease to be.

texts.zh:
在持续数月的轰炸后，一切都结束了。[From.GetName]陷落了，一切生命的迹象都消失了。在厚厚的尘埃云在由我们前首都化作的废墟街道中翻腾。死亡的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曝尸荒野，在我们中最伟大的一员，我们的先祖的身边堆作尸山，而先祖也在最后的轰炸中随之而去。

我们现在不得不把所有的行政能力转移到[capital_scope.GetName]，并且需要建立新的始祖巢穴。在敌人开始利用我们暂时的分崩离析前，我们必须将其中一个子嗣孵化为新的始祖。
texts.en:
After many months of bombardment, it is over. [From.GetName] has fallen, all trace of life has been eradicated. Dust clouds billow across the ruined streets of our former capital. Dead [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]  litter the ground, culminating in an enormous pile of corpses surrounding the greatest of us all - our Progenitor, which finally fell during the final bombardment.

We now have to move our administration to [capital_scope.GetName], and it will be necessary to establish a new Progenitor Nest. We will have to incubate one of our Offspring to assume the role of Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of this moment of disunity.
